zh.html: 摘要

en.html: Abstract

zh.html: 长程 LLM 智能体常因程序性错误而失败，例如忘记约束、弄错工具调用顺序，或过早停止。由于这些失误无法预测，同一个智能体可能在某次运行中成功，却在之后一次完全相同的任务中失败。由此产生的执行轨迹包含丰富信号，能够揭示哪些程序性选择会导向成功或失败；然而，现有从智能体轨迹中提取可复用指南的方法，要么因提炼不精确而引入噪声，要么在部署时依赖外部检索器。我们提出 SkillForge，这是一种无需训练的框架，重新思考程序性指南的构建和部署：它将同一任务的成功与失败尝试配对，以识别关键程序性选择；整合并过滤候选指南，去除低质量条目；而且只有当智能体的当前上下文表明指南与之相关时，才在推理时按需加载相关指南。在包括 τ²-Bench 和 Terminal-Bench 在内的智能体基准上，SkillForge 提高了重复运行的一致性；与基线相比，一致性差距最多缩小 37%，总 token 用量最多降低 23.6%，同时不降低单次试验表现。这些结果表明，从过往轨迹中提炼高质量程序性指南，是使长程智能体更加一致、高效的一条实用途径。

en.html: Long-horizon LLM agents often fail from procedural errors such as forgetting constraints, misordering tool calls, or stopping prematurely. Because these slips are unpredictable, the same agent can succeed on one run and fail on an identical task later. The resulting execution trajectories contain rich signals about which procedural choices lead to success or failure, yet existing approaches that extract reusable guidance from agent trajectories either introduce noise through imprecise distillation or depend on external retrievers for deployment. We propose SkillForge, a training-free framework that rethinks both the construction and deployment of procedural guidance: it pairs successful and failed attempts on the same task to identify critical procedural choices, consolidates and filters candidate guidance to remove low-quality entries, and loads relevant guidance on demand at inference time only when the agent’s current context signals its relevance. Across agent benchmarks including τ²-Bench and TerminalBench, SkillForge improves repeated-run consistency, reducing the consistency gap by up to 37% and lowering total token usage by up to 23.6% compared to baselines without degrading single-trial performance. These results suggest a practical path toward distilling high-quality procedural guidance from past trajectories for more consistent and efficient long-horizon agents.

zh.html: 1 引言

en.html: 1 Introduction

zh.html: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在需要规划、使用工具以及与外部环境持续交互的任务中，展现出了令人瞩目的能力（Yu et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2025；Shinn et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023；Yao et al., 2023；Wei et al., 2022）。许多实际任务是长程任务：解决一项客户服务请求，可能需要核实账户状态、检查政策资格，并在多个步骤中协调多个工具（Ye et al., 2026b）。在这些任务上，模型行为仍不可靠。对同一个或几乎相同的实例重复运行，经常会产生不同结果（Gan et al., 2025）；原因是忘记约束、弄错工具调用顺序或过早终止等微小的程序性偏差，会在较长的动作序列中累积（Wan et al., 2025a），使一致性成为实际应用中首要的关注点（Wang et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2025；Wan et al., 2025c）。

en.html: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities on tasks requiring planning, tool usage, and extended interaction with external environments (Yu et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025; Shinn et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2023; Yao et al., 2023; Wei et al., 2022). Many practical tasks are long-horizon: resolving a customer-service request may require verifying account status, checking policy eligibility, and coordinating across multiple tools over multiple steps (Ye et al., 2026b). On such tasks, model behavior remains unreliable. Repeated runs on the same or a nearly identical instance regularly produce different outcomes (Gan et al., 2025), as small procedural deviations such as forgetting a constraint, misordering tool calls, or terminating prematurely compound over the extended action sequence (Wan et al., 2025a), making consistency the dominant practical concern (Wang et al., 2024; Zhou et al., 2025; Wan et al., 2025c).

zh.html: 一种自然的应对方式，是改善推理时提供给智能体的上下文（Snell et al., 2025），并从过往错误中学习（Hu et al., 2026）。既有工作探索了情景记忆与语言形式的自我反馈（Shinn et al., 2023；Park et al., 2023；Packer et al., 2023）、持久化技能库（Zheng et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2026），以及自动归纳的指南（Fu et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2024；Li et al., 2026）。但关键局限仍然存在：检索出的指南往往噪声较多或过于详细，以无关上下文冲淡智能体的推理并浪费 token（Zhao et al., 2024；Xiong et al., 2025）；高质量指南通常需要昂贵的人工整理；自动生成的技能则往往过于泛化，难以在任务间可靠迁移（Li et al., 2026）。这提出了一个关键问题：如何在无需人工整理或外部检索器的情况下，自动从过往轨迹中提炼高质量指南，并在推理时高效部署它们？

en.html: A natural response is to improve the context supplied to the agent at inference time (Snell et al., 2025) and learn from past mistakes (Hu et al., 2026). Prior work has explored episodic memory and verbal self-feedback (Shinn et al., 2023; Park et al., 2023; Packer et al., 2023), persistent skill libraries (Zheng et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026), and automatically induced guidelines (Fu et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026). But key limitations remain: retrieved guidance is often noisy or overly detailed, diluting the agent’s reasoning with irrelevant context and wasting tokens (Zhao et al., 2024; Xiong et al., 2025); high-quality guidance typically requires costly human curation; and automatically generated skills tend to be too generic to transfer reliably across tasks (Li et al., 2026). This raises a key question: how can we automatically distill high-quality guidance from past trajectories and deploy it efficiently at inference time, without human curation or external retrievers?

zh.html: 回答这个问题的一项关键洞见来自近期有关难度感知学习的工作（Gao et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2025）：程序性指南最丰富的信号，位于成功与失败之间的决策边界。过于简单的任务（所有运行都通过）或过于困难的任务（所有运行都失败），几乎不能揭示哪些程序性选择起作用。信息量最大的，是智能体有时成功、有时失败的中等难度任务，因为这些结果混合的案例暴露了程序性选择发生分歧的位置。通过配对这些任务上的成功与失败尝试，我们获得对比性轨迹证据：这种证据不是分别总结哪里做对了、哪里做错了，而是分离出“在情境 X 中，做 Y，而不是 Z”形式的决定性程序差异，如图 1 所示。

en.html: A key insight to answer this question comes from recent work on difficulty-aware learning (Gao et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2025): the richest signal for procedural guidance lies at the decision boundary between success and failure. Tasks that are too easy (all runs pass) or too hard (all runs fail) provide little signal about which procedural choices matter. The most informative cases are tasks of intermediate difficulty where the agent sometimes succeeds and sometimes fails, as these mixed-outcome cases expose where procedural choices diverge. By pairing successful and failed attempts on such tasks, we obtain contrastive trajectory evidence: rather than separately summarizing what went right or wrong, this evidence isolates decisive procedural differences of the form “in situation X, do Y rather than Z.”, as illustrated in Fig. 1.

zh.html: 因此，我们提出 SkillForge，这是一种从过往轨迹中提炼可复用程序性指南的免训练框架。SkillForge 通过四个阶段将这一思想付诸实践：（1）收集对比轨迹——即同一任务上智能体有时成功、有时失败的执行——为哪些程序性选择具有决定作用提供直接证据；（2）通过提示生成器 LLM 对比成功与失败运行之间的程序差异，提取候选指南；（3）在留出任务上验证每个候选，丢弃不能提高通过率或产生净负面影响的候选；（4）在测试时按需检索，默认只展示轻量元数据，并通过显式工具调用加载完整技能内容。这种设计使默认输入保持精简，保留智能体自主性，并且只有当轨迹明确显示其相关性时，才提供详细的程序性支持。

en.html: We thus propose SkillForge, a training-free framework that distills reusable procedural guidance from past trajectories. SkillForge operationalizes this idea in four stages: (1) Collect contrastive trajectories—executions of the same task where the agent sometimes succeeds and sometimes fails— providing direct evidence about which procedural choices are decisive; (2) Extract candidate guidance by prompting a generator LLM to contrast procedural differences between successful and failed runs; (3) Validate each candidate on held-out tasks, discarding those that fail to improve pass rate or cause net-negative effects; and (4) Retrieve on demand at test time, exposing only lightweight metadata by default and loading full skill content through an explicit tool call. This design keeps the default input small, preserves agent autonomy, and surfaces detailed procedural support only when the trajectory makes its relevance clear.

zh.html: 我们在 τ²-Bench（Barres et al., 2025）和 Terminal-Bench（Merrill et al., 2026）上评估 SkillForge。SkillForge 改善了平均任务表现，并随着尝试次数 k 增加而保持更高的一致性。分析进一步表明，对比依据和验证过滤都是获得可靠技能质量的必要条件；按需加载也优于将完整内容注入提示词，因为过早展示指南会分散智能体的注意力，而不是帮助它。总之，我们的贡献是：（1）一种对比式提取原则，将混合结果任务上的成功与失败轨迹配对，以分离决定性的程序性选择，显著优于仅从单一结果极性或任务描述中导出的指南；（2）SkillForge，一种通过经验证的技能构建和分层按需检索将这一原则付诸实践的免训练框架，相较现有程序构建基线，一致性差距最多缩小 37%，token 用量最多降低 23.6%；（3）深入分析成功与失败轨迹的互补作用、轨迹预算对技能质量的扩展效应以及效率优势，同时提供实用部署指南和详细案例研究。

en.html: We evaluate SkillForge on τ²-Bench (Barres et al., 2025) and Terminal-Bench (Merrill et al., 2026). SkillForge improves average task performance and remains more consistent as the number of attempts k grows. Our analyses further reveal that contrastive grounding and validation filtering are both essential for reliable skill quality, and that on-demand loading outperforms full-prompt injection, as prematurely exposing guidance distracts the agent rather than helping it. In sum, our contributions are: (1) a contrastive extraction princi- ple that pairs successful and failed trajectories on mixed-outcome tasks to isolate decisive procedural choices, substantially outperforming guidance derived from a single outcome polarity or from task descriptions alone; (2) SkillForge, a training-free framework that operationalizes this principle through validated skill construction and hierarchical on-demand retrieval, reducing the consistency gap by up to 37% and token usage by up to 23.6% over existing procedure-building baselines; and (3) an in-depth analysis establishing the complementary roles of success and failure trajectories, the scaling effect of trajectory budget on skill quality, and the efficiency advantages, along with practical deployment guidelines and detailed case studies.

zh.html: 2 方法：SkillForge

en.html: 2 Method: SkillForge

zh.html: 本节介绍 SkillForge 的核心设计。如图 2 所示，我们首先收集同一批任务上结果有成有败的执行（§2.1），然后通过对比成功与失败轨迹提取并精炼候选技能（§2.2）。随后整合并过滤候选，只保留能可靠改善表现的技能（§2.2）。保留的技能在推理时按需提供给智能体（§2.3）。

en.html: This section presents the core design of SkillForge. As illustrated in Fig. 2, we first collect mixed-outcome executions on the same tasks (§2.1), then extract and refine candidate skills by contrasting successful and failed trajectories (§2.2). Candidates are subsequently consolidated and filtered to retain only skills that reliably improve performance (§2.2). The retained skills are then exposed to the agent on demand at inference time (§2.3).

zh.html: 术语。一致性是指智能体在同一任务的独立运行中产生相同正确结果的程度，以 Passᵏ 衡量（见 §3.1）。程序性指南指从过往轨迹中提取的、可复用且可操作的知识，例如决策规则、优选工具调用顺序及错误恢复模式，用于引导智能体采取正确行为；我们仅用“经验”指代原始轨迹，不指代由其派生的产物。技能是程序性指南用于存储和检索的具体封装格式（Anthropic, 2025；Li et al., 2026）：每个技能包含名称、用于轻量元数据匹配的简短描述，以及指定触发条件、关键程序、常见失败变体和协调规则的正文。

en.html: Terminology. Consistency is the degree to which an agent produces the same correct outcome across independent runs on the same task, measured via Passk (see §3.1). Procedural guidance refers to reusable, actionable knowledge extracted from past trajectories, such as decision rules, preferred tool-call orderings, and error-recovery patterns, which steers the agent toward correct behavior; we use experience exclusively to refer to raw trajectories, not to derived artifacts. A skill is the concrete format in which procedural guidance is packaged for storage and retrieval (Anthropic, 2025; Li et al., 2026): each skill contains a name, a short description for lightweight metadata matching, and a body specifying trigger conditions, a key procedure, common failure variants, and reconciliation rules.

zh.html: 2.1 轨迹收集

en.html: 2.1 Trajectory Collection

zh.html: 我们使用互不重叠的技能归纳集、验证集和测试集，以防止数据泄漏。对每个基准，保留官方测试划分作为 T<sub>test</sub>，并将官方训练划分随机分成相等的两半：T<sub>train</sub> 用于技能归纳，T<sub>val</sub> 用于经验验证。技能只从 T<sub>train</sub> 归纳，只在 T<sub>val</sub> 上过滤，只在 T<sub>test</sub> 上评估；测试集从不用于技能构建或验证。对每个任务 t ∈ T<sub>train</sub>，我们在 K 种不同配置 {c₁, c₂, …, c_K} 下执行智能体，产生一组轨迹 {τ<sub>t</sub><sup>c₁</sup>, τ<sub>t</sub><sup>c₂</sup>, …, τ<sub>t</sub><sup>c<sub>K</sub></sup>}。每条轨迹记录观察与动作的序列，以及二元结果 r<sub>t</sub><sup>c</sup> ∈ {0, 1}，表示配置 c 在任务 t 上失败还是成功。这里，配置指对智能体超参数的特定选择，例如采样温度和推理强度（思考预算），同时保持骨干模型和环境不变。¹

en.html: We use disjoint skill-induction, validation, and test sets to prevent data leakage. For each benchmark, we preserve the official test split as T<sub>test</sub> and randomly partition the official training split into two equal halves: T<sub>train</sub> for skill induction and T<sub>val</sub> for empirical validation. Skills are induced only from T<sub>train</sub>, filtered only on T<sub>val</sub>, and evaluated only on T<sub>test</sub>; the test set is never used during skill construction or validation. For each task t ∈ T<sub>train</sub>, we execute an agent under K different configurations {c1,c2,...,cK }, producing a set of trajectories {τ<sub>t</sub><sup>c₁</sup>, τ<sub>t</sub><sup>c₂</sup>, …, τ<sub>t</sub><sup>c<sub>K</sub></sup>}. Each trajectory records the sequence of observations, actions, and a binary outcome r<sub>t</sub><sup>c</sup> ∈ {0, 1} indicating whether configuration c failed or succeeded on task t. Here, a configuration refers to a specific choice of agent hyperparameters, such as sampling temperature and reasoning effort (thinking budget), while holding the backbone model and environment fixed.¹

zh.html: 2.2 对比式技能提取与验证

en.html: 2.2 Contrastive Skill Extraction and Validation

zh.html: 给定每个任务 t ∈ T<sub>contrast</sub> 的成功与失败轨迹集合，我们提示生成器 LLM G，识别成功尝试与失败尝试之间的行为差异，以提取候选技能。对每个任务 t，我们分别从 S<sub>t</sub> 和 F<sub>t</sub> 中最多采样 m 条成功轨迹与 m 条失败轨迹，向 G 提供任务描述 d<sub>t</sub>、包含关键决策点和观察到的失败模式的采样轨迹，以及结构化提取指令（完整提示词模板见附录 C）：

en.html: Given the successful and failed trajectory sets for each task t ∈ T<sub>contrast</sub>, we prompt a generator LLM G to extract candidate skills by identifying the behavioural differences that distinguish successful attempts from failed ones. For each task t, we sample up to m successful and m failed trajectories from S<sub>t</sub> and F<sub>t</sub> respectively, and provide G with the task description d<sub>t</sub>, the sampled trajectories with key decision points and observed failure modes, and structured extraction instructions (full prompt templates in Appendix C):

zh.html: 阶段 1：基于 LLM 的精炼。生成不佳的技能可能适得其反，因为它们会占用上下文、产生冲突指令或误导智能体（Ye et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026b）。基于既有工作所确定的高质量技能标准（Li et al., 2026），我们提示 G 按四项标准评估并修改每个候选：可操作性（具体、可执行的步骤，而非含糊建议）、范围（针对特定失败模式，而非充当宽泛手册）、通用性（能从源实例迁移到相似任务）和简洁性（保持在目标 token 预算内）。每个候选在每项标准上获得通过／不通过的二元判断；任何一项不通过的候选都会被修改，修改后仍不具通用性的候选则被丢弃。

en.html: Stage 1: LLM-based refinement. Poorly generated skills can be counterproductive by consuming context, creating conflicting instructions, or misleading the agent (Ye et al., 2026a; Zhang et al., 2026b). Based on prior work identifying criteria for high-quality skills (Li et al., 2026), we prompt G to evaluate and revise each candidate against four criteria: actionability (concrete, executable steps rather than vague advice), scope (targets a specific failure pattern rather than serving as a broad manual), generality (transfers beyond the source instance to similar tasks), and conciseness (remains within a target token budget). Each candidate receives a binary pass/fail judgment per criterion; those failing any criterion are revised, and those that remain non-general after revision are discarded.

zh.html: 阶段 2：技能整合与更新。从对比配对中归纳出候选技能 {c_i}_{i=1}^N 后，我们通过增量式技能库更新过程整合它们。首先，将每个候选规范化为标准技能格式，包含名称、描述、使用条件、可选的不使用条件、程序性指南和失败特征。然后，根据任务触发条件、工具使用模式、约束及失败模式的重叠情况，从当前技能库 L 中检索相似的已有技能。如果某个已有技能已经覆盖候选的触发条件、失败特征和纠正程序，则将候选视为冗余，仅合并有用示例或更精确的表述。如果它贡献了独特要素，例如新的任务子类型、适用边界、工具使用序列或反复出现的失败模式，则将其加入为新技能。在插入前，通过缩小候选范围、增加不使用条件，或重写程序使不同技能适用于不同情境，解决它与已有技能的冲突。这个过程优先选择具体、可操作的技能，而不是宽泛提醒；由于智能体最初仅根据技能元数据决定加载什么，因此也保留了运行时的选择性。附录 D.1 给出了具体工作流示例：

en.html: Stage 2: Skill consolidation and update. After candidate skills {c_i}_{i=1}^N are induced from contrastive pairs, we consolidate them through an incremental library update process. Each candidate is first normalized into a standard skill format with a name, description, use condition, optional do-not-use condition, procedural guidance, and failure signature. We then retrieve similar existing skills from the current library L based on overlap in task triggers, tool-use patterns, constraints, and failure modes. If an existing skill already covers the candidate’s trigger, failure signature, and corrective procedure, the candidate is treated as redundant and only useful examples or sharper wording are merged. If it contributes a distinct element, such as a new task subtype, applicability boundary, tool-use sequence, or recurring failure mode, it is added as a new skill. Conflicts with existing skills are resolved before insertion by narrowing the candidate’s scope, adding a do-not-use condition, or rewriting the procedure so that the skills apply to different situations. This process favors specific, actionable skills over broad reminders, preserving runtime selectivity because the agent initially decides what to load from skill metadata alone. zh.html: 2.3 分层按需检索

en.html: 2.3 Hierarchical On-Demand Retrieval

zh.html: 将完整技能库预加载到提示词中会浪费上下文，并可能损害奖励和一致性（Fu et al., 2024）。失败模式不仅是 token 膨胀：当许多技能同时展示时，用户请求与无关技能之间的表面关键词重叠，可能使智能体加载并遵循错误指南，以无技能基线本可避免的方式违反政策（图 16）。SkillForge 将每个技能组织为深度递增的层次，只让智能体按当前任务需要向下深入。最浅层仅包含元数据（简短名称和描述），中间层展示决策规则或诊断模式，终端层包含代码模板或逐步修复程序等最重的资源。每个非终端层都指定一个下钻条件，用自然语言描述何时加载下一层（例如，“确认根本原因后，检索修复模板”）。层数因领域而异：对延迟敏感的任务通常只需一至两个轻量层，而对精度敏感的任务则受益于更深的层次（见 §B.6）。

en.html: Preloading the full skill repository into the prompt wastes context and can hurt both reward and consistency (Fu et al., 2024). The failure mode is not merely token bloat: when many skills are exposed at once, surface keyword overlap between the user’s request and unrelated skills can cause the agent to load and follow the wrong guidance, violating policy in ways that the no-skill baseline would have avoided (Fig. 16). SkillForge instead organises each skill into layers of increasing depth and lets the agent descend only as far as the current task requires. The shallowest layer holds only metadata (a short name and description), intermediate layers expose decision rules or diagnostic patterns, and terminal layers contain the heaviest resources such as code templates or step-by-step repair procedures. Each non-terminal layer specifies a descent condition, a natural-language description of when to load the next layer (e.g., “retrieve the repair template once the root cause is confirmed”). The number of layers varies by domain: latency-sensitive tasks typically need only one or two lightweight layers, while precision-sensitive tasks benefit from deeper hierarchies (see §B.6).

zh.html: 在回合开始时，只把每个保留技能的元数据层附加到系统提示词；更深层以文件形式保存在专用技能目录中。我们提供单个工具 load_skill(skill_name)，将下一层尚未观察到的内容注入工作上下文。每一轮，智能体都会根据上下文（包括最近观察到的层）决定是否调用该工具。这里不涉及嵌入索引、向量数据库或学习型检索器：LLM 对当前上下文是否匹配下钻条件的判断，是唯一的门控机制。

en.html: At episode start, only the metadata layer of each retained skill is appended to the system prompt; deeper layers reside as files in a dedicated skill directory. We expose a single tool, load_skill(skill_name), which injects the next unobserved layer into the working context. At any turn, the agent decides whether to invoke this tool based on the context, including the most recently observed layer. No embedding index, vector database, or learned retriever is involved: the LLM’s own judgment of whether the current context matches a descent condition is the sole gating mechanism.

zh.html: 3 实验

en.html: 3 Experiments

zh.html: 本节首先介绍实验设置，包括基准、模型、基线和评估指标（§3.1）。随后呈现主要结果，围绕三个问题展开：SkillForge 是否改善任务有效性、是否提高重复运行的一致性，以及这些提升是否具有有利的效率权衡（§3.2）；最后给出案例分析及实际使用场景的讨论（§3.3）。

en.html: This section first describes our experimental setup, including benchmarks, models, baselines, and evaluation metrics (§3.1). We then present the main results, focusing on three questions: whether SkillForge improves task effectiveness, whether it improves repeated-run consistency, and whether these gains come with favorable efficiency trade-offs (§3.2), and finally present case analyses and discussions on practical usage scenarios (§3.3).

zh.html: 3.1 实验设置

en.html: 3.1 Experimental Setup

zh.html: 基准。我们在三个主要基准上评估 SkillForge：τ²-Bench Airline 和 τ²-Bench Retail，通过多步工具调用对话评估受政策约束的客服智能体；Terminal-Bench 则在需要长动作序列的故障诊断与修复任务上评估软件工程智能体。对于 τ²-Bench 领域，我们使用 τ² 中经修正的任务集（Barres et al., 2025），它解决了原始发布版本中存在的标注错误和不可能满足的约束（Yao et al., 2025）。我们省略了新引入的 Telecom 领域，因为 Gemini 3.0 Flash 等新模型已使其接近饱和（准确率超过 90%），且其 2,285 个任务使评估成本高昂。此外，我们在代理监督的补充分析中报告 SkillsBench 的结果（§3.3）。

en.html: Benchmarks. We evaluate SKILLFORGE on three primary benchmarks: τ²-Bench Airline and τ² - Bench Retail, which evaluate policy-constrained customer-service agents over multi-step tool-call dialogues; and Terminal-Bench, which evaluates software-engineering agents on fault-diagnosis and repair tasks requiring long action sequences. For the τ²-Bench domains, we use the corrected task set from τ² (Barres et al., 2025), which resolves annotation errors and impossible constraints present in the original release (Yao et al., 2025). We omit the newly introduced Telecom domain, as new models like Gemini 3.0 Flash already saturate it (above 90% accuracy) and its 2,285 tasks make evaluation expensive. We additionally report results on SkillsBench in a supplementary analysis of proxy supervision (§3.3).

zh.html: 模型。主要实验使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash（gemini-2.5-flash）、Gemini 3 Flash Preview（gemini-3-flash-preview），部分实验使用 GPT-5 Nano（gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07）。我们优先采用这些轻量模型，以支持对智能体重复执行开展广泛且成本高效的评估。所有消融和诊断分析均使用 Gemini 3 Flash Preview。

en.html: Models. Our main experiments use Gemini 2.5 Flash (gemini-2.5-flash), Gemini 3 Flash Preview (gemini-3-flash-preview), and, in selected experiments, GPT-5 Nano (gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07). We prioritize these lightweight models to support broad and cost-efficient evaluation across repeated agent executions. All ablations and diagnostic analyses use Gemini 3 Flash Preview.

zh.html: 基线。我们比较三种方法：No Skill（无技能）、Self-Generated Skill（仅从任务描述生成、不使用轨迹证据的技能，采用 SkillsBench 的实现（Li et al., 2026））和 SkillForge（我们通过对比提取、经验证过滤的技能）。在消融研究中还纳入 Reasoning Bank（Ouyang et al., 2026）（图 4），以检验框架的整体设计。虽然两种方法都从过往轨迹中学习以改善未来智能体行为，Reasoning Bank 在推理时检索指南的方式有所不同：它依赖基于外部嵌入的检索器选择相关记忆，而 SkillForge 通过元数据匹配及显式的基于 bash grep 的工具调用，在预先精炼的路径检索目录，从而提供技能。由于检索机制不能直接比较，我们分离出它们的记忆生成和整合阶段（这些阶段按单条轨迹顺序更新记忆库），并对两种方法都保留我们的检索机制，以进行受控比较。

en.html: Baselines. We compare three methods: No Skill, Self-Generated Skill (skills generated from task descriptions without trajectory evidence, using the SKILLSBENCH implementation (Li et al., 2026)), and SkillForge (our contrastively extracted, validation-filtered skills). We additionally include Reasoning Bank (Ouyang et al., 2026) in the ablation study (Fig. 4) to test the overall design of our framework. While both our and their methods learn from past trajectories to improve future agent behavior, Reasoning Bank differs in how guidance is retrieved at inference time: it relies on external embedding-based retrievers to select relevant memories, whereas SkillForge exposes skills via metadata matching and an explicit bash grep-based tool call to retrieve the folders at pre-refined paths. Because the retrieval mechanisms are not directly comparable, we isolate their memory-generation and consolidation stages (which update their memory banks sequentially from individual trajectories) and keep our retrieval mechanism for both for a controlled comparison.

zh.html: 指标。我们通过 Pass@1 报告单次试验表现，通过 Passᵏ 报告重复运行一致性。对每个任务 t，设 n 次独立执行中有 c<sub>t</sub> 次成功，我们遵循 τ-bench（Yao et al., 2025），计算 Passᵏ(t) = C(c<sub>t</sub>, k) / C(n, k)，并在任务间取平均。主要实验中 n = 5，因此 Pass⁵ 要求任务的全部五次执行均成功。我们进一步报告相对一致性 RC = Pass⁵ / Pass@1 ∈ [0, 1]，其中 Pass@1 = Pass¹，RC = 1 表示完全一致。我们将一致性差距定义为 1 − RC；所报告的一致性差距缩小百分比，均为这个量的相对缩减。更多设置细节见附录 B.1。

en.html: Metrics. We report single-trial performance via Pass@1 and repeated-run consistency via Pass<sup>k</sup> . For each task t, with c<sub>t</sub> successes over n independent executions, we follow τ-bench (Yao et al., 2025) and compute Pass^k(t) = binom(c<sub>t</sub>, k) / binom(n, k) , averaged over tasks. In our main experiments, n = 5, so Pass<sup>5</sup> requires all five executions of a task to succeed. We further report relative consistency, RC = Pass<sup>5</sup>/Pass@1 ∈[0,1], where Pass@1 = Pass<sup>1</sup> and RC = 1 indicates perfect consistency. We define the consistency gap as 1−RC; reported percentage reductions in the consistency gap are relative reductions in this quantity. More setup details are in Appendix B.1.

zh.html: 3.2 主要结果

en.html: 3.2 Main Results

zh.html: 整体表现与一致性。表 1 报告了三个模型系列的结果。在单次试验表现（Pass@1）上，SkillForge 总体上优于基线，在不同基准与基础模型的全部设置中均持续取得提升。主要收益在于一致性：每一个模型—基准配对的 RC 都得到改善，绝对增幅介于 2.7 至 13.1 个百分点。最大提升出现在使用 Gemini 3.0 Flash 的 τ²-Bench Airline 上（+13.1 个百分点，0.552 → 0.683，相对提高 24%）。

en.html: Overall performance and consistency. Table 1 reports results across three model families. On single-trial performance (Pass@1), SkillForge is broadly superior to the baselines, with consistent gains in all settings on different benchmarks and base models. The primary benefit lies in consistency: RC improves in every model–benchmark pair, with absolute gains ranging from 2.7 to 13.1 percentage points. The largest improvement is on τ²-Bench Airline with Gemini 3.0 Flash (+13.1pp, 0.552→0.683, a 24% relative improvement).

zh.html: 技能构建的轨迹预算扩展。记忆构建阶段呈现出一条有用的扩展规律，与既有关于在信息采集中平衡探索和利用的动态采样研究相一致（Wan et al., 2025b）。如图 3 所示，将采样预算从 4 条轨迹增至 12 条，会持续提高相对无技能基线的重复运行一致性，因为额外轨迹有助于找到更多中等难度任务，从而增强可供提取的对比信号。

en.html: Trajectory-budget scaling for skill construction. The memory-construction stage exposes a useful scaling rule that is consistent with prior work on dynamic sampling that balances exploration and exploitation in information gathering (Wan et al., 2025b). As shown in Fig. 3, increasing sampling budget from 4 to 12 trajectories consistently improves repeated-run consistency over the no-skill baseline, because additional trajectories help find more intermediate-difficulty tasks, strengthening the contrastive signal available for extraction.

zh.html: 超过这个范围后，在所有 k 值上，采样 16 条轨迹与 12 条轨迹的表现相当。图 3 的中图和右图解释了原因：首先，12 条和 16 条轨迹产生的混合结果配对比例相同，说明额外采样不再发现智能体行为不一致的新的中等难度任务。其次，技能加载百分比，即智能体至少调用一个技能的任务比例，也在同一点饱和（12 条与 16 条轨迹均为 75%），证实额外轨迹预算没有产生智能体更常认为相关的技能。综合来看，超过适度轨迹预算后，额外采样产生的对比信号递减，新增技能效用也很少。实践中，适中的预算（此处为 12 条轨迹）能以合理的采样成本捕获大部分有用信号。

en.html: Beyond this, sampling with 16 trajectories per-forms comparably to 12 across all values of k. The middle and right panels of Fig. 3 explain why: First, 12 and 16 trajectories yield the same proportion of mixed-outcome pairs, indicating that the additional samples no longer surface new intermediate difficulty tasks on which the agent behaves inconsistently. Second, the skill load percentage, the fraction of tasks in which the agent invokes at least one skill, also saturates at the same point (75% for both 12 and 16 trajectories), confirming that the extra trajectory budget does not produce skills that the agent finds relevant more often. Together, these results suggest that beyond a modest trajectory budget, additional samples yield diminishing contrastive signal and little additional skill utility. In practice, a moderate budget (here, 12 trajectories) captures most of the useful signal at reasonable sampling cost.

zh.html: 消融研究。图 4 沿两个轴分解了 SkillForge 各组成部分的贡献：不同 Passᵏ 下的一致性（左）和总 token 成本（右）。在以轨迹为依据的变体中，Grounding (Success) Only（仅成功轨迹依据）的一致性曲线最稳定，说明成功轨迹为可在多次运行间迁移的可复用行为提供了最强信号；不过，它在 k = 1 时未优于无技能基线，且 token 成本显著更高。Grounding (Failed) Only（仅失败轨迹依据）在较小 k 时优于基线，但随着 k 增大下降更快，说明失败轨迹包含有用的错误规避线索，却不足以单独归纳出稳定指南。这种对照支持了我们的设计理由：成功轨迹展示应保留什么，失败轨迹展示应避免什么，两者结合才能分离最重要的程序差异。移除验证阶段（No-validation/filter）在 k = 1 时与 SkillForge 相当，但随着 k 增大，其 Passᵏ 急剧下降，token 成本同时上升，证实未经筛选的技能无法维持一致性，并以低效用指南使上下文膨胀。最后，在 §3.1 所述的受控比较中，两种方法使用相同的 SkillForge 检索机制，Reasoning Bank（Ouyang et al., 2026）的顺序记忆生成与整合程序不及 SkillForge 的对比式、经验证过滤的构建程序，而且差距随 k 增大而扩大。综合这些结果可知，对比依据与验证过滤互为补充：依据决定生成什么指南，过滤决定保留什么指南。提示词细节见附录 C。

en.html: Ablation Studies. Fig. 4 breaks down the contributions of each SkillForge component along two axes: consistency across Passk (left) and total token cost (right). Among the trajectory-grounding variants, Grounding (Success) Only yields the most stable consistency curve, suggesting that successful trajectories provide the strongest signal for reusable behavior that transfers across runs; however, it does not improve over the no-skill baseline at k = 1 and incurs substantially higher token cost. Grounding (Failed) Only improves over the baseline at smaller k but degrades more quickly as k grows, indicating that failed trajectories contain useful erroravoidance cues yet are insufficient on their own to induce stable guidance. The contrast supports our design rationale: successful trajectories show what to preserve, failed trajectories show what to avoid, and their combination isolates the procedural differences that matter most. Removing the validation stage (No-validation/filter) matches SkillForge at k = 1 but its Passk drops sharply as k grows while token cost rises, confirming that unfiltered skills fail to sustain consistency and bloat context with low-utility guidance. Finally, under the controlled comparison described in §3.1, where both methods use the same SkillForge retrieval mechanism, Reasoning Bank (Ouyang et al., 2026)’s sequential memory-generation and consolidation procedure is outperformed by SkillForge’s contrastive, validation-filtered construction procedure, with the gap widening at larger k. Together, these results indicate that contrastive grounding and validation filtering are complementary: grounding determines what guidance to generate, while filtering determines what guidance to keep. The prompt details are provided in Appendix C.

zh.html: 效率权衡。SkillForge 通过指南质量与提供方式两方面提高效率。图 4（右）表明，低质量或较差的指南可能在削弱表现的同时增加 token 用量。仅从成功轨迹或仅从失败轨迹中提取、未经适当验证的技能，缺少对比精度，可能误导智能体并导致无效探索或回溯，如附录图 14 和图 16 的零售失败案例所示。Reasoning Bank 等方法呈现出另一种互补的局限：由于它们的指南没有为渐进式加载而组织，可能不论相关性如何都提前展示全部指南，增加上下文长度，却未必有助于当前决策；SkillForge 通过对比依据和验证过滤改善技能内容，同时通过分层按需加载改善技能提供方式，从而避免这两类问题。与此解释一致，附录表 3 中的提供方式消融显示，按需加载取得最佳奖励、最强的 Passᵏ 保持能力以及最低 token 用量，较无技能减少 16.7% token，较完整提示词指南减少 23.6%。

en.html: Efficiency trade-offs. SkillForge improves efficiency through both guidance quality and delivery. Fig. 4 (right) shows that lower-quality or poorly guidance can increase token usage while weakening performance. Skills extracted from successful or failed only trajectories without proper validation lack contrastive precision, which can mislead the agent and induce unproductive exploration or backtracking, as illustrated by the retail failure case in Appendix Fig. 14 and 16. Methods such as Reasoning Bank present a complementary limitation: because their guidance is not structured for progressive loading, they may expose all guidance upfront regardless of relevance, increasing context length without necessarily helping the current decision; SkillForge avoids both issues by using contrastive grounding and validation filtering to improve skill content, together with hierarchical on-demand loading to improve skill delivery. Consistent with this explanation, the delivery ablation in Appendix Table 3 shows that on-demand loading achieves the best reward, strongest Passk retention, and lowest token usage, reducing tokens by 16.7% over no-skill and 23.6% over full-prompt guidance.

zh.html: 3.3 实践分析

en.html: 3.3 Practical Analysis

zh.html: 案例研究：用户施压下的工作流控制。τ²-Bench 中反复出现的一种失败模式，不是误判正确政策，而是在用户持续施压下放弃政策。智能体经常已经识别出符合政策的操作，却在用户反驳、援引先前建议或重新表述请求时偏离政策，提出不受支持的变通方案，将原本各自有效的工具拼接成政策未允许的序列。SkillForge 通过稳定识别后的决策来缓解这类失败：智能体一旦识别出适用约束，加载相关技能模块就会将它锚定在获准的解决路径上（例如升级处理、拒绝或推迟），而不是即兴编造替代方案。其作用与其说是改善智能体知道什么，不如说是改善它在受到质疑时是否坚持边界。图 5 用一个有代表性的取消场景说明这一模式：无技能智能体和 SkillForge 智能体都正确判断预订 EHGLP3 不符合退款资格，但只有 SkillForge 智能体通过加载 skill-impasse-escalation，继续调用 transfer_to_human_agents，而不是在用户施压下编造“先升舱再取消”的变通方案。更多案例研究见附录图 13。

en.html: Case Study: Workflow Control Under User Pressure. A recurring failure mode in τ²-Bench is not misidentifying the correct policy, but abandoning it under sustained user pressure. Agents frequently recognize the policy-compliant action, then drift away from it when the user pushes back, citing prior advice, or reframes the request, producing unsupported workarounds that stitch together otherwise-valid tools into a sequence the policy does not sanction. SkillForge mitigates this class of failure by stabilizing post-recognition decisionmaking: once the agent has identified the applicable constraint, loading a relevant skill module anchors it to the sanctioned resolution path (e.g., escalation, refusal, or deferral) rather than improvising an alternative. The effect is less about improving what the agent knows and more about improving whether it holds the line when challenged. Fig. 5 illustrates this pattern in a representative cancellation scenario: both the no-skill and SkillForge agents correctly determine that reservation EHGLP3 is refund-ineligible, but only the SkillForge agent, by loading the skill-impasse-escalation, proceeds to transfer_to_human_agents instead of fabricating an upgrade-then-cancel workaround under user pressure. Additional case studies are provided in Appendix Figure 13.

zh.html: 对近似监督的稳健性。主要流程使用真实任务结果区分成功与失败轨迹，但实践中往往无法获得这种监督。为检验近似反馈是否足够，我们用 LLM 评判器替换真实标签，并在 SkillsBench（Li et al., 2026）上评估；这是一个近期提出、旨在测试智能体技能使用的长程基准。如图 6 所示，真实标签如预期产生最强一致性，但代理监督仍是一种实用替代。它持续优于自生成技能，并保留了相对无技能基线的大部分一致性提升。代理评判器与真实轨迹标签的一致率为 77%，与既有 LLM 轨迹评估工作报告的一致率相当（Zheng et al., 2023）。这表明，适度的标签噪声不会显著削弱对比式提取阶段。

en.html: Robustness to Approximate Supervision. Our main pipeline uses golden task outcomes to separate successful and failed trajectories, but such supervision is often unavailable in practice. To test whether approximate feedback is sufficient, we replace gold labels with an LLM judge and evaluate on SKILLSBENCH (Li et al., 2026), a recent long-horizon benchmark designed to test skill usage in agents. As shown in Fig. 6, golden labels yield the strongest consistency, as expected, but proxy supervision remains a practical alternative. It consistently outperforms self-generated skills and preserves most of the consistency gain over the no-skill baseline. The proxy judge achieves 77% agreement with gold trajectory labels, comparable to agreement rates reported in prior work on LLM-based trajectory evaluation (Zheng et al., 2023). This suggests that moderate label noise does not substantially weaken the contrastive extraction stage.

zh.html: 4 相关工作

en.html: 4 Related Work

zh.html: 用于智能体自我改进的经验记忆。LLM 智能体的一项核心挑战，是保留并复用过往经验。奠基性方法探索了自我反思和情景记忆检索（Shinn et al., 2023；Park et al., 2023；Packer et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023）。更新的工作将轨迹提炼为经验教训、工作流和推理轨迹等结构化产物（Zhao et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024；Ouyang et al., 2026；Suzgun et al., 2025；Wang and Li, 2026），并明确管理规划与执行之间的抽象边界（Ye et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2025）。然而，这些系统假定存储的经验正确；近期研究显示，错误或低质量产物可能降低表现（Zhu et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026）。课程感知学习表明，与其仅按正确性过滤，不如以信息量丰富、难度适当的示例为目标，这会产生更稳健的泛化（Wang et al., 2025；Qi et al., 2025）。SkillForge 基于这两项观察：有选择地针对多次运行结果有成有败的任务，将由此得到的对比证据提炼为结构化技能产物；这些产物无需基于外部嵌入的检索器或学习型检索器，即可按需加载。

en.html: Experience Memory for Agent Self-Improvement. A central challenge for LLM agents is retaining and reusing past experience. Foundational approaches explore self-reflection and episodic memory retrieval (Shinn et al., 2023; Park et al., 2023; Packer et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2023). More recent work distills trajectories into structured artifacts such as lessons, workflows, and reasoning traces (Zhao et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2024; Ouyang et al., 2026; Suzgun et al., 2025; Wang and Li, 2026), and explicitly manages abstraction boundaries across planning and execution (Ye et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2025). However, these systems assume the stored experience is correct; recent studies show that incorrect or low-quality artifacts can degrade performance (Zhu et al., 2025; Li et al., 2026). Rather than filtering for correctness alone, curriculum-aware learning suggests that targeting informative, appropriately difficult examples yields more robust generalization (Wang et al., 2025; Qi et al., 2025). SkillForge builds on both observations: it selectively targets tasks where outcomes are mixed across runs and distills the resulting contrastive evidence into structured skill artifacts that can be loaded on demand without an external embedding-based or learned retriever.

zh.html: 从基于检索的记忆到智能体技能。基于经验改善智能体的一个关键问题，是如何在推理时提供存储的知识。检索增强方法通过基于嵌入的相似性搜索查询情景记忆库（Lewis et al., 2020；Fan et al., 2024；Fang et al., 2025；Hu et al., 2025）。一种正在兴起的替代方式，将可复用程序封装为面向渐进式披露的声明式技能，在相关时作为有针对性的上下文按需加载（Zhou et al., 2026a；Zheng et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026a；Ni et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b,a；Lu et al., 2026），使产物与架构无关、可共享且高效（Anthropic, 2025）。然而，高质量技能仍主要由人工编写（Anthropic, 2026；Zhou et al., 2026b）；自生成的低质量技能甚至可能损害表现（Li et al., 2026）。SkillForge 通过将过往轨迹中的对比证据提炼为声明式技能，弥合这一差距；它无需逐技能人工整理，也无需在推理时使用基于外部嵌入的检索器或学习型检索器，就能提高程序性一致性。

en.html: From Retrieval-Based Memory to Agent Skills. A key question in experience-based agent improve- ment is how stored knowledge is surfaced at inference time. Retrieval-augmented approaches query episodic memory banks via embedding-based similarity search (Lewis et al., 2020; Fan et al., 2024; Fang et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025). An emerging alternative packages reusable procedures as declarative skills designed for progressive disclosure, loaded on-demand as targeted context when relevant (Zhou et al., 2026a; Zheng et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2026a; Ni et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2026b,a; Lu et al., 2026), making artifacts architectureagnostic, shareable, and efficient (Anthropic, 2025). However, high-quality skills remain mostly human-authored (Anthropic, 2026; Zhou et al., 2026b); self-generated, low quality skill can even hurt per-formance (Li et al., 2026). SkillForge bridges this gap by distilling contrastive evidence from past trajectories into declarative skills, improving procedural consistency without manual per-skill curation or an external embedding-based or learned retriever at inference time.

zh.html: 5 结论

en.html: 5 Conclusion

zh.html: 我们介绍了 SkillForge，一种从具有对比性的过往轨迹中提炼可复用程序性指南的框架。通过配对智能体的成功与失败尝试、验证候选技能，以及按需加载保留的指南，SkillForge 识别并部署可操作的程序性知识，以实现可靠的长程智能体。在多种智能体基准上，SkillForge 提高了重复运行一致性，同时不降低单次试验表现。这些结果表明，对比依据和选择性部署是实现长程智能体可靠性的有效要素；从结构化的成功—失败差异中学习，是自动生成高质量技能的一个有前景的方向。

en.html: We introduced SkillForge, a framework that distills reusable procedural guidance from contrastive past trajectories. By pairing successful and failed agent attempts, validating candidate skills, and loading retained guidance on demand, SkillForge identifies and deploys actionable procedural knowledge for reliable long-horizon agents. Across diverse agentic benchmarks, SkillForge improves repeated-run consistency without degrading performance in single-trial performance. These results show that contrastive grounding and selective deployment are effective ingredients for long-horizon agent reliability and learning from structured success–failure differences is a promising direction for automated, high-quality skill generation.

zh.html: 局限性

en.html: Limitations

zh.html: SkillForge 存在若干局限，这些局限共同界定了当前范围与自然延伸方向。

en.html: SkillForge has several limitations that shape both its current scope and natural extensions.

zh.html: 评估范围。我们的实验涵盖受政策约束的客户服务对话（τ²-Bench Airline、Retail）和命令行软件工程（Terminal-Bench）。这些领域共享一种对分析至关重要的属性，但并未覆盖长程智能体设置的全部范围。我们没有评估 Web 智能体、GUI 智能体或开放式生成任务；在这些任务中，成功更难验证，程序性模式也可能更加分散。将对比式提取原则扩展到这些设置，是自然的下一步，尤其是 DeepResearch 与 GUI 智能体：它们常出现混合结果轨迹，但奖励信号噪声更大。

en.html: Evaluation scope. Our experiments cover policy-constrained customer-service dialogue (τ²-Bench Airline, Retail) and command-line software engineering (Terminal-Bench). These domains share a property critical to our analysis, but they do not exercise the full range of long-horizon agent settings. We do not evaluate on web agents, GUI agents, or open-ended generation tasks where success is harder to verify and where procedural patterns may be more diffuse. Extending the contrastive extraction principle to these settings, particularly to DeepResearch and GUI agents where mixed-outcome trajectories are common but reward signals are noisier, is a natural next step.

zh.html: 所针对的失败模式。SkillForge 针对反复发生的程序性错误导致的失败：工具调用顺序错误、遗漏约束、过早终止，或未能协调冲突状态。主要受限于事实知识缺失、根本性的困难推理缺口或高度开放式生成的任务，较不可能从中受益，因为可复用程序性指南无法提供基础模型所不具备的能力。框架改进的是智能体如何在长程中运用自身能力，而不是扩展这些能力。

en.html: Failure modes addressed. SkillForge targets failures from recurring procedural errors: misordered tool calls, missed constraints, premature termination, or failure to reconcile conflicting state. Tasks dominated instead by missing factual knowledge, fundamentally hard reasoning gaps, or highly open-ended generation are less likely to benefit, since reusable procedural guidance cannot supply capabilities the base model lacks. The framework improves how agents apply their capabilities over long horizons rather than expanding those capabilities.

zh.html: 检索受模型判断限制。按需加载依赖基础模型仅凭元数据识别存储指南何时相关。逐技能诊断（附录 B.5）表明，一旦触发调用，通常是恰当的；但若某个模型系统性地过少或过多加载技能，收益就会被稀释。轻量级检索辅助机制，例如与元数据一起显示触发匹配提示，可以在不重新引入完整嵌入式检索成本的情况下提高召回率。

en.html: Retrieval bounded by model judgment. Ondemand loading relies on the base model to recognize when stored guidance is relevant from metadata alone. Our per-skill diagnostics (Appendix B.5) show that invocations are usually appropriate when they fire, but a model that systematically under-loads or over-loads skills would dilute the benefit. Lightweight retrieval-assist mechanisms, e.g., trigger-match hints surfaced alongside metadata, could improve recall without reintroducing the cost of full embedding-based retrieval.

zh.html: B.1 基础设施与评估设置

en.html: B.1 Infrastructure and Evaluation Settings

zh.html: 基础设施。所有实验、技能归纳运行和智能体评估均使用 Google 的 Agent Development Kit（ADK）进行编排，并通过 Vertex AI API 访问 Gemini 模型系列。为在标准化环境中开展评估，我们改造了 τ²-Bench 和 Terminal-Bench 的原始代码库，使其原生兼容 ADK 框架。

en.html: Infrastructure. All experiments, skill induction runs, and agent evaluations were orchestrated using Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK), with the Vertex AI API used to access the Gemini model family. To evaluate on standardized environments, we adapted the original codebases of τ²-Bench and Terminal-Bench to be natively compatible with the ADK framework.

zh.html: 数据划分。对于 τ²-Bench，我们遵循基准提供的官方训练／测试划分。由于没有官方验证集，我们将官方训练集随机分成相等的两半：T<sub>train</sub> 用于技能归纳，T<sub>val</sub> 用于经验验证，同时保持官方测试集 T<sub>test</sub> 不变，用于最终评估。我们对 Terminal-Bench 应用相同过程。在所有情况下，T<sub>test</sub> 从不用于技能构建或验证。在 T<sub>train</sub> 内，T<sub>contrast</sub> 仅表示同时观察到成功与失败轨迹的任务子集。

en.html: Data splits. For τ²-Bench, we follow the official train/test split provided by the benchmark. Because no official validation split is available, we randomly partition the official training set into two equal halves: T<sub>train</sub> for skill induction and T<sub>val</sub> for empirical validation, while keeping the official test set T<sub>test</sub> untouched for final evaluation. We apply the same procedure to Terminal-Bench. In all cases, T<sub>test</sub> is never used during skill construction or validation. Within T<sub>train</sub>, T<sub>contrast</sub> denotes only the subset of tasks for which both successful and failed trajectories are observed.

zh.html: 轨迹收集。为在技能构建中产生混合结果轨迹，我们在一小组推理时配置下运行同一任务。具体而言，将解码温度从 0.5 变化到 1.0，并依据骨干模型改变推理预算。对于 Gemini 2.5 Flash，使用 8192 token 和 auto 两种推理预算；对于 Gemini 3.0 Flash，使用 low、medium 和 high 思考等级。这些变化只用于轨迹收集，以增加混合结果任务的数量，并暴露同一任务上的多样程序性行为。留出验证阶段只保留下游影响为正的技能，从而缓解特定配置造成的产物偏差。

en.html: Trajectory collection. To induce mixed-outcome trajectories for skill construction, we run the same task under a small set of inference-time configurations. In particular, we vary the decoding temperature from 0.5 to 1.0 and also vary the reasoning budget depending on the backbone model. For Gemini 2.5 Flash, we use reasoning budgets of 8192 tokens and auto; for Gemini 3.0 Flash, we use low, medium, and high thinking levels. These variations are used only during trajectory collection to increase the number of mixed-outcome tasks and expose diverse procedural behaviors on the same task. Configuration-specific artifacts are mitigated by the held-out validation stage, which retains only skills with positive downstream impact.

zh.html: 评估设置。除非另有说明，我们以解码温度 1.0 评估智能体，每个任务运行 5 次试验以估计一致性。确切模型名称、试验次数及并发设置随每张实验表报告，而不假定所有基准都采用同一全局配置。

en.html: Evaluation settings. Unless otherwise stated, we evaluate agents at decoding temperature 1.0 and run 5 trials per task for consistency estimation. Exact model names, trial counts, and concurrency settings are reported alongside each experiment table, rather than assuming a single global configuration across all benchmarks.

zh.html: 流程默认设置。技能生成默认使用对比模式：对比式起草中，每个结果组（成功和失败）最多使用 6 条轨迹；单一结果起草最多使用 4 条轨迹。生成器 LLM 以低温度运行（起草为 0.25，批量精炼为 0.15），并输出结构化 JSON，以保证候选技能可解析。保留技能池上限为 50 个技能；起草时向生成器展示至多 20 个已有技能，以减少冗余。政策文本截断为 6,000 个字符，以保持在上下文限制内。个别实验脚本可能在注明处覆盖这些默认值；完整配置细节见随附代码仓库。

en.html: Pipeline defaults. Skill generation uses contrastive mode by default, with up to 6 trajectories per outcome group (successful and failed) for contrastive drafting and up to 4 trajectories for single-outcome drafting. The generator LLM is run at low temperature (0.25 for drafting and 0.15 for batch refinement) with structured JSON outputs to ensure parseable skill candidates. The retained skill pool is capped at 50 skills, with up to 20 existing skills shown to the generator during drafting to reduce redundancy. Policy text is truncated at 6,000 characters to stay within context limits. Individual experiment scripts may override these defaults where noted; full configuration details are provided in the accompanying code repository.

zh.html: 生成的技能。我们概述本方法在生成、精炼和过滤后所使用的最终技能集。对于航空领域，实验使用的最终技能集包含 7 个技能：airline-baggage-allowance-logic、airline-cancellation-refund-validation、airline-disruption-compensation-and-disputes、airline-itinerary-search-optimization、airline-mirror-booking-workflow、airline-modification-financial-validation 和 airline-rebooking-workflow。这些技能对应航空智能体中反复出现的决策点，例如退款验证、重新订票、行程搜索、付款与票价差额核查，以及航班中断相关的补偿处理。

en.html: Skills Generated. We summarize the final skill sets used by our method after generation, refinement, and filtering. For the airline domain, the final skill set used in our experiments contains 7 skills: airline-baggage-allowance-logic, airline-cancellation-refund-validation, airline-disruption-compensation-and-disputes, airline-itinerary-search-optimization, airline-mirror-booking-workflow, airline-modification-financial-validation, and airline-rebooking-workflow. These skills correspond to recurring airline-agent decision points, such as refund validation, rebooking, itinerary search, payment and fare-difference checking, and disruption-related compensation handling.

## 第 1 层：元数据与描述
- 描述：确保用户多部分请求中所有不同组成部分都得到确认和处理，防止仅部分满足。
## 第 2 层：指南
### 一般指南
- 始终解析用户初始陈述中的所有显式和隐式意图。
- 确认理解多部分请求的全部部分。
- 不要假定一种请求类型优先于另一种。
- 如果存在多个意图，向用户澄清先处理哪一部分。
- 在确认所有组成部分前，避免处理请求中的任何部分。
### 具体指南
- 如果用户既提问又请求操作，确认两者并询问：“我理解您有关于商品的问题，也想发起退货。您希望先处理哪一个？”
- 在发起任何交易操作（例如退货）之前，明确确认涉及的具体商品或细节。
- 如果存在信息查询，确保已回答，或在用户同意下明确推迟处理。
- 如果同时存在信息查询，避免立即执行交易请求。
- 在执行任何操作之前，使用概括性陈述确认已理解请求的所有部分。
## 第 3 层：上下文
- 问题模式：未能处理用户多部分请求中所有不同的组成部分。
- 状态特征：用户初始陈述包含多个不同请求或意图（例如信息查询和交易操作）。
- 绕过策略：
  1. 识别用户话语中的所有不同意图。
  2. 向用户确认每个已识别意图。
  3. 明确询问用户希望先处理哪一部分。
  4. 在处理任何交易部分前，确认与该交易有关的具体细节。

description: Ensures all distinct components of a user's multi-part request are acknowledged and addressed, preventing partial fulfillment.

## Layer 1: Metadata & Description
- Description: Ensures all distinct components of a user's multi-part request are acknowledged and addressed, preventing partial fulfillment.
## Layer 2: Guidelines
### General Guidelines
- Always parse the user's initial statement for all explicit and implicit intents.
- Confirm understanding of all parts of a multi-part request.
- Do not assume prioritization of one request type over another.
- Seek user clarification on which part to address first if multiple intents are present.
- Avoid proceeding with any part of a request until all components are acknowledged.
### Specific Guidelines
- If a user asks questions AND requests an action, acknowledge both and ask,'I understand you have questions about products and also want to initiate returns. Which would you like to tackle first?'
- Before initiating any transactional action (like returns), explicitly confirm the specific items or details involved.
- If an informational query is present, ensure it is addressed or explicitly deferred with user consent.
- Avoid immediately executing a transactional request if an informational query is also present.
- Use a summary statement to confirm all understood parts of the request before proceeding with any action.
## Layer 3: Context
- Problem Pattern: Failing to address all distinct components of a multi-part user request.
- State Signature: User's initial statement contains multiple, distinct requests or intents (e.g., informational query and transactional action).
- Bypass Strategy:
1. Identify all distinct intents within the user's utterance.
2. Acknowledge each identified intent to the user.
3. Explicitly ask the user which component they would like to address first.
4. Before proceeding with any transactional component, confirm specific details related to that transaction.

This concentration suggests that a small number of procedural decision points dominate the domain, consistent with our motivating claim that consistency failures stem from a bounded set of recurring slip patterns rather than broad capability gaps.

en.html: Conditional success varies but stays above baseline on average. Per-skill success rates range from 33.3% to 93.3%, with six of seven skills exceeding or closely matching the no-skill baseline of 55.2%. The single exception (itinerary-search-optimization) was retained because it produced positive average impact on the validation split (Eq. 4)—it helps the tasks it loads on, even though those tasks are intrinsically hard.

zh.html: Token 效率。一个自然的问题是，正文报告的提升来自提取技能的内容、推理时提供技能的机制，还是两者兼有。为分离提供方式的贡献，我们固定技能池，只改变向智能体展示技能的方式：（i）No Skill，未增强的基线；（ii）Full Prompt Guidance，在回合开始时把所有保留技能串接到系统提示词中；（iii）On-Demand Loading，采用分层检索，默认只展示元数据，当智能体判断相关时才通过显式工具调用加载完整技能内容。

en.html: Token Efficiency. A natural question is whether the gains reported in the main text come from the content of the extracted skills, the delivery mechanism used to surface them at inference time, or both. To isolate the contribution of delivery, we hold the skill pool fixed and vary only how skills are exposed to the agent: (i) No Skill, the unaugmented baseline; (ii) Full Prompt Guidance, in which all retained skills are concatenated into the system prompt at episode start; and (iii) On-Demand Loading, the hierarchical retrieval, where only metadata is exposed by default and full skill content is loaded through an explicit tool call when the agent judges it relevant.

zh.html: 表 3 从四个维度报告 Terminal-Bench 结果：平均奖励、从单次试验到重复运行的一致性（Pass@1 → Pass⁵）、token 用量，以及按轮数衡量的对话长度。有三项观察尤为突出。首先，尽管与 On-Demand Loading 使用相同技能池，Full Prompt Guidance 的奖励甚至低于 No Skill 基线（0.493 对 0.512）。这表明，不论相关性如何都预加载全部指南，会用低效用内容冲淡智能体的推理，在没有适用技能的任务上还可能主动误导它。其次，On-Demand Loading 同时取得最佳奖励、从 Pass@1 到 Pass⁵ 的最小一致性下降，以及最低 token 用量，较 No Skill 减少 16.7% token，较 Full Prompt Guidance 减少 23.6%。节省 token 并不是牺牲质量的权衡，而是选择性检索的结果：只有当当前轨迹明确显示相关性时，智能体才加载详细程序性内容。第三，Full Prompt Guidance 使用的轮数（27.1）少于其他变体，但这反映的是过早终止而非效率；预加载上下文使智能体偏向最突出的技能，从而更早确定行动路线，这与其较低奖励一致。

en.html: Table 3 reports results on Terminal-Bench across four axes: average reward, single-trial-to-repeated-run consistency (Pass@1 →Pass5), token usage, and conversation length in turns. Three observations stand out. First, Full Prompt Guidance underperforms even the No Skill baseline on reward (0.493 vs. 0.512), despite having access to the same skill pool as On-Demand Loading. This suggests that preloading all guidance regardless of relevance dilutes the agent’s reasoning with low-utility content and can actively mislead it on tasks where no skill applies. Second, On-Demand Loading achieves the best reward, the smallest consistency drop from Pass@1 to Pass5 , and the lowest token usage simultaneously, reducing tokens by 16.7% over No Skill and 23.6% over Full Prompt Guidance. The token savings are not a trade-off against quality but a consequence of selective retrieval: the agent loads detailed procedural content only when the current trajectory makes its relevance clear. Third, Full Prompt Guidance uses fewer turns (27.1) than the other variants, but this reflects premature termination rather than efficiency, the agent commits to a course of action earlier because the preloaded context biases it toward whichever skill is most prominent, which is consistent with its lower reward.

zh.html: 综合来看，这些结果表明，对比依据（生成什么指南）与按需提供（何时展示指南）互为补充：在错误时机展示高质量技能，表现可能不如完全没有技能；而同样的技能经分层检索提供时，则在我们测量的每个维度上取得最强结果。

en.html: Together, these results indicate that contrastive grounding (what guidance to generate) and on-demand delivery (when to surface it) are complementary: high-quality skills exposed at the wrong time can underperform no skills at all, while the same skills routed through hierarchical retrieval yield the strongest results on every axis we measure.

en.html: B.6 Task Adaptivity and Progressive Disclosure

zh.html: 程序性指南适当的深度与格式，取决于目标任务的复杂性特征。SkillForge 不强制单一技能模板；相反，每个技能的结构会根据任务需求调整。图 7 展示了两种代表性情形的对比。

en.html: The appropriate depth and format of procedural guidance depends on the complexity profile of the target task. SkillForge does not enforce a single skill template; instead, the structure of each skill is adapted to match what the task demands. Fig. 7 illustrates this contrast along two representative regimes.

en.html: Figure 7: Progressive disclosure is task-adaptive. Conversational tasks (τ2-Bench) are latency-sensitive and often benefit from stopping after lightweight metadata or short situational snippets. Engineering tasks (Terminal-Bench) more often justify deeper staged retrieval, exposing specialised repair templates only after the failure subtype is identified.

zh.html: 对于短程、延迟敏感的任务——即所需工具调用较少、奖励快速果断回应的任务——轻量文本指南就已足够。这些设置的技能主要由触发条件和简洁的优选程序构成：简短的情境规则与决策边界，让智能体能快速吸收而不使上下文膨胀。Tau-Bench 代表了这种情形，其中大多数交互只涉及少量政策查询与工具调用。

en.html: For short-horizon, latency-sensitive tasks— those that require relatively few tool calls and reward fast, decisive responses—lightweight text-based guidance is sufficient. Skills for these settings consist primarily of trigger conditions and a concise preferred procedure: short situational rules and decision boundaries that the agent can absorb quickly without context bloat. Tau-Bench, where most interactions involve a handful of policy lookups and tool calls, exemplifies this regime.

zh.html: 对于长程、精度敏感的任务——即需要多次顺序工具调用、多步诊断或迭代修复的任务——技能受益于更深、渐进披露的结构。首先展示元数据与诊断模式，只有智能体识别出相关失败子类型后，才加载 shell 脚本、代码模板和逐步修复序列等更重的内容。Terminal-Bench 代表了这种情形，其中单个任务可能在诊断、补丁修改和验证中涉及数十次工具调用。例如，async-proxy-method-delegation 这类技能在元数据层包含 traceback 匹配模式，但将模板保留到按需检索时；若在已知失败子类型前就注入这些材料，会既无必要又分散注意力。

en.html: For long-horizon, precision-sensitive tasks— those that require many sequential tool calls, multi-step diagnosis, or iterative repair—skills benefit from a deeper, progressively disclosed structure. Metadata and diagnostic patterns are exposed first, while heavier content such as shell scripts, code templates, and step-by-step repair sequences is loaded only after the agent identifies the relevant failure subtype. Terminal-Bench, where a single task may involve dozens of tool calls across diagnosis, patching, and verification, exemplifies this regime. For instance, a skill like async-proxy-method-delegation includes traceback-matching patterns at the metadata level but reserves its templates for on-demand retrieval, material that would be unnecessary and distracting if injected before the failure subtype is known.

zh.html: 更广泛地说，设计原则是让技能粒度随任务复杂性扩展：简单任务需要简洁决策规则，复杂任务则受益于分层内容，随着轨迹缩小问题范围逐步展示。各基准技能格式的详细信息见附录 B.3。

en.html: More broadly, the design principle is that skill granularity should scale with task complexity: simple tasks need concise decision rules, while complex tasks benefit from layered content that is revealed progressively as the trajectory narrows the problem. Details on the skill format for each benchmark are provided in Appendix B.3.

zh.html: 本附录说明 SkillForge 如何将归纳出的候选技能整合到现有技能库。整合不是简单的追加操作：每个候选均会被规范化、与相近的已有技能比较、检查冗余或冲突，最终被合并、拒绝或作为新技能加入。

en.html: This appendix illustrates how SKILLFORGE consolidates an induced candidate skill into the existing skill library. Consolidation is not a simple append operation: each candidate is normalized, compared against nearby existing skills, checked for redundancy or conflict, and either merged, rejected, or added as a new skill.

zh.html: 归纳出的候选。考虑 TAU2-RETAIL 环境中的一条失败轨迹。用户询问：“你能检查一下我最近订单的收货地址吗？我可能需要修改它。”失败智能体立即更新用户个人资料地址，或未先展示当前地址并确认预期范围，就修改订单地址。相反，成功轨迹首先检索当前订单地址，向用户展示，询问修改适用于当前订单还是账户默认地址，并在执行更新前确认确切的新地址。归纳阶段从这一对比配对提出以下候选：

I might need it changed.” A failed agent immediately updates the user’s profile address, or changes an order address without first showing the current address and confirming the intended scope. In contrast, a successful trajectory first retrieves the current order address, shows it to the user, asks whether the change applies to the current order or to the account default, and confirms the exact new address before executing the update. From this contrastive pair, the induction stage proposes the following candidate: desc: distinguish checking, order

en.html: Step 1: Normalize the candidate. The candidate is first rewritten into the standard skill format used by the library: a name, short description, use condition, optional do-not-use condition, procedural guidance, and failure signature. This normalization makes the candidate comparable to existing skills and ensures that the runtime agent can later decide whether to load it from metadata alone.

The existing skills cover broad verification and modification-confirmation behavior, while the candidate introduces a more specific boundary condition:

name: confirm-address-update-scope
description: 确保智能体在执行任何地址修改前，区分检查地址、更新某一订单的收货地址，以及更新个人资料／默认地址。

## 何时使用
当用户要求检查、核实、确认或修改地址，但操作的预期范围不明确时，使用此技能。
## 何时不使用
当用户已明确指定确切地址和确切范围时，不要使用此技能。
## 程序性指南
- 将包含“检查”“核实”或“确认”的地址请求优先视为信息验证。
- 在提出或执行修改之前，检索并展示当前相关地址。
- 如果用户说地址错误，询问更正后的地址，以及它适用于当前订单、多个订单，还是默认／个人资料地址。
- 在执行更新前，重述确切订单 ID 或个人资料范围，以及新地址。
- 除非用户明确要求，不要将地址变更应用于所有订单或个人资料。
## 失败特征
智能体在模糊的检查／修改请求后，执行范围错误的地址更新。
## 绕过策略
1. 识别是在检查还是修改。
2. 检索并展示地址。
3. 必要时询问更正后的地址。
4. 询问修改适用于一个订单、多个订单，还是个人资料。
5. 重述确切范围与地址。
6. 确认后执行更新。

en.html:
---
name: confirm-address-update-scope
description: Ensures agent distinguishes between checking an address, updating one order's shipping address, and updating a profile/default address before executing any address change.
metadata:
  benchmark: tau2_retail
  source: consolidated_from_failures
---
## When to Use
Use this skill when the user asks to check, verify, confirm, or change an address, but the intended scope of the action is ambiguous.
## Do Not Use When
Do not use this skill when the user has clearly specified both the exact address and the exact scope.
## Procedural Guidance
- Treat address requests containing "check", "verify", or "confirm" as information-verification first.
- Retrieve and display the current relevant address before proposing or executing a change.
- If the user says the address is wrong, ask for the corrected address and whether it applies to the current order only, multiple orders, or the default/profile address.
- Before executing an update, restate the exact order ID or profile scope and the new address.
- Do not apply an address change to all orders or to the profile unless explicitly requested.
## Failure Signature
Agent performs an address update with wrong scope after a vague check/change request.
## Bypass Strategy
1. Identify if checking or changing.
2. Retrieve and display address.
3. Ask for corrected address if needed.
4. Ask if change applies to order, multiple orders, or profile.
5. Restate exact scope and address.
6. Execute update after confirmation.

zh.html: 阶段 1 的 LLM 审查器判定候选不符合四项核心标准中的三项。可操作性不通过，因为“谨慎行事”和“再次核查”不是可执行程序——技能未指出要检查的状态、要调用的工具或终止条件。范围不通过，因为触发条件（“任何修改”）混合了换货、地址更新、取消和商品修改，而这些需要不同程序。通用性以无益的方式不通过：候选措辞宽泛，却缺少具体、反复出现的失败特征，因此无法迁移到任何特定情形。严格来说，只有简洁性得到满足（候选很短），但精炼评分准则恰恰因此将少于 200 token 的候选视为可疑。该候选还与已保留技能（confirm-specific-modification-details、prevent-unconfirmed-irreversible-action）冗余，因此被丢弃而不是修改。

en.html: The Stage 1 LLM reviewer rejects this candidate on three of the four core criteria. Actionability fails because “be careful” and “double-check” are not executable procedures—the skill names no state to inspect, no tool to call, and no termination condition. Scope fails because the trigger (“any change”) conflates exchanges, address updates, cancellations, and item modifications, which require distinct procedures. Generality fails in the unhelpful direction: the candidate is broadly worded but lacks a concrete recurring failure signature, so it transfers to nothing in particular. Only conciseness is technically satisfied (the candidate is short), but the refinement rubric treats sub-200-token candidates as suspect for exactly this reason. The candidate is also redundant with already-retained skills (confirm-specific-modification-details, prevent-unconfirmed-irreversible-action) and is discarded rather than revised.

zh.html: 候选达到最低使用阈值（21 次调用 ≥ 5），但平均影响严格为负（δ̄<sup>[s]</sup> = −0.095 < 0，不符合公式 4）。检查轨迹表明，该技能鼓励了过早升级处理：在本可通过标准工具序列解决的任务上，智能体转交人工或调用紧急程序，导致相对于相同匹配任务上的无技能基线，奖励下降。这个案例说明了阶段 3 的作用：候选可能格式良好、可操作且被频繁调用，却仍会降低部署表现。没有经验验证，这类技能就会悄然稀释技能池。

en.html: The candidate met the minimum usage threshold (21 invocations ≥ 5) but showed a strictly negative average impact (¯ δ[s] =−0.095 < 0, violating Eq. 4). Inspection of its trajectories suggests the skill encouraged premature escalation: the agent transferred to a human or invoked emergency procedures on tasks that could have been resolved through standard tool sequences, lowering reward relative to the no-skill baseline on the same matched tasks. This case illustrates the role of Stage 3: a candidate may be well-formed, actionable, and frequently invoked, yet still degrade performance in deployment. Without empirical validation, such a skill would silently dilute the skill pool.

After repeated user pivots between exchange and return requests, the agent fails to fully reset its workflow state, retaining a stale action policy. The loaded skill (CX.skill: delivered-order-returns) is mismatched to the task’s exchange-then-return structure, illustrating how imprecise skill selection can degrade rather than improve performance.

en.html: Figure 15: Mixed-outcome trajectories on identical inputs (τ-bench retail). Three independent runs of the same agent on the same user request share an identical 3-step prefix (top) but diverge at step 4. Trial 0 (left) issues an invalid multi-item exchange without verifying the keyboard catalog, while Trials 1–2 (right) check availability and correctly exchange only the thermostat. This kind of outcome split on a shared prefix is precisely the signal SkillForge mines to extract procedural guidance.

en.html: Figure 16: Failure mode: skill interference under flat retrieval. When all candidate skills are exposed at once (a), surface keyword overlap between the user’s phrasing (“sooner,” “non-stop”) and unrelated skills (find_cheapest_flight_deals) causes the retriever to load an irrelevant skill while the correct one (manage_basic_economy_restrictions) is ranked lower (b). The agent then executes the spurious skill’s instructions and violates policy. This motivates the on-demand, trigger-conditioned retrieval design used by SkillForge, which gates skill loading on structured trigger conditions rather than free-text similarity alone.
